title: Event, publication, observation and knowledge times
summary: Dev9 uses resolved LibrarianTimePoint objects and scalar UTC seconds from pinned Single Time Service v0.3 to enforce independent publication and observation cutoffs. Dev9 corrections cannot rewrite earlier as-of snapshots. The separate Single Time Service engineering sphere identifies a newer v0.9 line, so an explicit API and zone-data compatibility audit is required before migration; current dev9 tests do NOT qualify v0.9.
invariants: Never infer local timezone from current host settings.
Historical as-of evaluation must exclude claims not published or not observed at its respective cutoff.
Correction and retraction histories must remain reconstructible; later observations do not retroactively alter historical knowledge.
Time Services may evolve: bind to verified semantic API; do not build a competing time service in Librarian.
Never silently upgrade v0.3 to v0.9 without reviewing both exact dependencies and rerunning native interpreter tests.

provenance.claim: Time adapter, observation and knowledge cutoff implementation.
